channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, EU, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:

    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.
